hypothesis: Adding legal temporal context fields that DeepFM can cross with user/item ids will improve within-user ranking and likely add marginal portfolio gain by correcting context-specific ordering errors without using any post-exposure inference feature.
implementation_plan: Apply the trusted legal_temporal_context operator exactly as catalogued. This changes the features block only by configuring SO.build_features to append hour and strictly-earlier user exposure-gap buckets fit on selected train rows, leaving model/loss/train unchanged.
justification: This is the mandated applicable first-round exploit for the baseline parent and is directly consumable by the current backend. DeepFM benefits from additional categorical context because its interaction mechanism is feature crossing; hour and prior-gap are legal pre-impression pair features that can alter ordering within a user while preserving leakage safety.
